Name: 0 · Heian Jingu Kaikan
Notes: Dinner venue: Heian Jingu Kaikan (平安神宮会館), beside the shrine. Final meeting time and event arrangements will be announced separately.

Name: 1 · Kyoto Handicraft Center
Notes: Browse Japanese crafts and gifts. March–December 10:00–19:00. Workshops are separately booked.

Name: 2 · KYOTO ROKURO
Notes: Japanese tea and an antique gallery near Heian Jingu. 10:00–18:00; last order 17:30. Closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

Name: 3 · Okazaki Shrine
Walk from dinner venue: Northeast of Heian Jingu; short stop
Notes: Rabbit statues and a small, quiet shrine precinct. A short outdoor stop northeast of Heian Jingu. Visit in daylight and follow local access notices.

Name: 4 · 58DINER
Notes: A casual diner with craft beer, sweets and food. Open from 11:00; closed Mondays. Official pages differ on evening closing time; check the current shop information.

Name: 5 · Tsutaya Books / Modern Terrace / Starbucks
Notes: Books 10:00–20:00; Modern Terrace 11:00–22:00 serves coffee, Kyoto craft beer and sake (drink orders until 21:00); Starbucks 08:00–22:00 with irregular holidays. Same Park Plaza building.

Name: 6 · Kyoto Museum of Crafts and Design / Miyakomesse
Notes: Indoor crafts museum on B1 of Miyakomesse. Open 10:00–18:00; museum admission until 17:30. Building arrival reference on the north side; allow time to reach B1. Adult admission JPY500.

Name: 7 · KYOCERA Museum / ENFUSE
Notes: Museum galleries: 10:00–18:00, last admission 17:30. ENFUSE cafe has separate hours: 10:30–19:00, last orders 18:00.

Name: 8 · Keiryu Bridge / Okazaki Canal
Notes: Waterside walk and views of the great torii. Use public paths.

Name: 9 · Lake Biwa Canal Museum
Notes: Indoor canal museum: 09:00–17:00, last admission 16:30. The nearby canal walks are separate outdoor stops.

Name: 10 · Keage Incline / lower end
Notes: Arrival point at the northern lower end of the former boat railway. The full slope takes extra time. Visit while light and follow access notices.

Name: 11 · Blue Bottle Coffee Kyoto Cafe
Notes: A seated coffee break near Nanzen-ji; 44 seats. Open daily 08:00–18:00. This is the main cafe, not the reservation-only Lounge.

Name: 12 · Nanzen-ji Sanmon area
Notes: Free outdoor grounds: see the Sanmon gate exterior and continue to the Suirokaku aqueduct. Paid visits only: last admission 16:10, close 16:30 in December. Distance is to Sanmon; the aqueduct is a further walk. Visit while light and follow local access notices.

Name: 13 · Furukawacho Arcade / BEER Komachi
Notes: Walk through the shopping arcade; individual shops have their own hours. BEER Komachi opens 17:00 on weekdays; a pub visit is better after dinner.

Name: 14 · Shirakawa / Ipponbashi bridge
Notes: A small stone bridge, willows and riverside streets. Enjoy the view without needing to cross the narrow bridge.

Name: 15 · Chion-in Sanmon gate front
Notes: See the Sanmon exterior from the public approach outside the temple gates. This stop does not require entering the grounds. Temple gates close 16:00 per the Japanese guide; the Sanmon interior is not normally open.

Name: 16 · Gion Yamaneko Kyoto Sake & Beer
Notes: Kyoto sake and craft beer in Gion. Usual hours 13:00–23:00; last order 22:30. A longer walk or after-dinner option; allow time to return.
